offer.heading: About this offering
offer.body: Befaro is an open-source, local-first health platform under the MIT license. Use is free of charge; no sales take place through these pages. The app links to the privacy notices of the supported AI providers, plus a voluntary donation option via GitHub (Liberapay, GitHub Sponsors, Ko-fi, PayPal).

liability-content.heading: Liability for content
liability-content.body: The content of these pages and of the app was created with the greatest care. However, the operator gives no guarantee for the correctness, completeness, or timeliness of the content. Health data that users create in the app stays on their own device; each user is responsible for their own content. Befaro is a documentation tool, not a medical device; it does not make diagnoses and does not replace medical advice.

liability-links.heading: Liability for links
liability-links.body: The app and these pages contain links to external third-party websites over whose content the operator has no control. The respective provider or operator of those pages is always responsible for such external content. The linked pages were checked for possible legal violations at the time of linking; permanent monitoring of linked content is not reasonable without concrete evidence of a violation. Such links will be removed immediately upon becoming aware of a legal violation.
